scope: Reconcile pre-R2018 linked-MTEXT column XDATA with the completed R2018 standalone embedded-object profile and refine existing PAR-19/7K readiness.

method.kind: Official DXF reference, versioned peer documentation, open issue, and local source/plan audit
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: PAR-19/7E and 7K legacy-column boundary; current R2018 MTEXT progress and validation receipt
src/drw_entities.h: ordered typed DRW_Entity::extData and DRW_MText R2018-specific model fields
src/drw_entities.cpp and src/libdxfrw.cpp: generic XDATA parse/write and standalone MTEXT version gate
tests/dxf_fixture_tests.cpp: generated R2018 ASCII/binary column controls
method.limitations: ezdxf's examples are implementation documentation, not an Autodesk normative schema. The ixmilia/dxf issue contains a user-reported AutoCAD 2015/Autodesk Viewer result and was not independently reproduced; its attachment was not downloaded. The Autodesk generic field table does not fully scope legacy direct tags versus XDATA or nested R2018 groups.

evidence.observed: The official reference lists column type/count/reversed/auto-height/width/gutter fields and assigns group 50 both to rotation and to a column-height/count note, without resolving all version and container scope in the table.
doesNotEstablish: that all listed column fields are direct entity pairs for every DXF version
evidence.planUse: Do not parse or emit legacy column fields as unscoped direct group pairs. Admit only explicit version/container profiles backed by source evidence.

evidence.observed: The docs describe linked self-sufficient MTEXT entities with the head entity's ACAD_MTEXT_COLUMN_INFO XDATA bracket, keyed typed pairs 75/79/76/78/48/49 and optional 50 manual-height count/data; separate ACAD_MTEXT_COLUMNS key 47 plus 1005 linked handles; and a separate ACAD_MTEXT_DEFINED_HEIGHT key 46. The examples warn that XDATA key 76 may differ from actual linked entity count; linked entities have no back-link and may be interleaved.
doesNotEstablish: normative Autodesk status for every sub-key or producer ordering
that every linked handle resolves or that entities should be merged
native rendering or cross-consumer column layout equivalence
evidence.planUse: Keep typed XDATA decoding separate from graph joining; bound counts and arrays independently; preserve raw typed XDATA and separate linked MTEXT callbacks until graph and consumer semantics are specified.

evidence.observed: The open issue discussion says an AutoCAD 2015 example used ACAD XDATA for column information and reports that a hand-converted ordinary-group-code form was rejected by AutoCAD 2015 and Autodesk Viewer. The attached drawing was not accessed or reproduced.
evidence.planUse: Treat flat legacy tag emission as a risk and require exact native producer evidence before adding another legacy wire profile.

readinessRefinement: Keep pre-R2018 ACAD_MTEXT_COLUMN_INFO and linked-MTEXT XDATA separate from the completed standalone AC1032 group-101 profile.
Parse only explicit ACAD XDATA brackets and typed sub-key/value pairs; retain unknown items and original source order.
Keep XDATA key 76, linked-profile key 47, and the 1005 handle-list length distinct; resolve links as a post-pass and do not merge entities without a specified consumer contract.
Require exact producer/native evidence before adding flat pre-R2018 direct-tag interpretation or output.
For any future local 7K slice, use bounded generated fast tests and handle-remap/sentinel controls; keep native and peer work at composed gates.
